note: Registered Z3 consumer and RID matrix (0.24 G1). scripts/test_z3_hermetic.py checks this file against the csproj item list, the asset verifier, every workflow, and every registered test project; tests/Shared/Z3ConsumerGuardTests.cs reads it at run time in every registered test host.

bootstrap.source: Checksum-pinned upstream Z3Prover/z3 4.15.7 archives; every extracted output is then verified against the asset pins. This is the only acquisition path for builds, tests, and packing. Builds never download: ValidateZ3Assets fails when an asset is missing or wrong.

unsupportedRids.reason: Upstream's x64-osx archive contains an arm64 binary; Intel macOS is unsupported for verification. A test host on this RID fails Z3ConsumerGuardTests instead of skipping.
.NET 10 has no x86 SDK. The asset stays pinned in the asset manifest but is never copied to build output or packed.

testHosts.projects: Every project in eng/test-manifest.json. Each one references Calor.Compiler directly or transitively and links the guard.

platformDivergences.note: Calor.Verification.Tests cases that load Z3 and run, but give a different result on Windows than on Linux and macOS. z3-consumer-matrix deselects exactly the cases in tests on the listed RIDs, and its TRX check requires every other case to pass with zero skips. G1 (PR #1471, run 37020428891) registered three; the #1135 repair fixed their causes and removed them (resolved), so nothing is deselected. Whether they are deterministic is decided by the #1421 protocol execution, not by this list.

resolved.name: Calor.Verification.Tests.IntegrationTests.StringInBodyOnly_StillNeverElides
resolved.observed: Windows reports Calor0712 (postcondition may be violated, counterexample result=1) where Linux and macOS report the expected Assumed demotion. Platform-dependent verifier verdict.
resolved.cause: Context.MkString marshals its argument as an ANSI string: UTF-8 on Linux and macOS, the active code page on Windows, so "é" had length 1 on Windows instead of the byte model's 2. ContractTranslator now passes non-ASCII UTF-8 bytes as Z3 escapes (#1135).

resolved.name: Calor.Verification.Tests.ContractTranslatorSemanticsVersionGuardTests.TranslatorOutputMatchesCommittedBaseline
resolved.observed: Translator fixture hash 4df8978f... on Windows against committed 95e8039c... (same SemanticsVersion).
resolved.cause: The fixture text was joined with AppendLine (CRLF on Windows). It now joins with LF (#1135).

resolved.name: Calor.Verification.Tests.VerifierRuntimeDifferential.VerifierRuntimeDifferentialTests.CommittedReportsMatchGeneratedOracle
resolved.observed: The regenerated differential report contains CR (13) bytes on Windows; the committed report is LF-only.
resolved.cause: System.Text.Json's indented writer uses Environment.NewLine. The report writer now sets NewLine to LF, and the Markdown writer writes LF directly (#1135).
